purpose: Real-trade-price replay of the soccer draw base-rate rule; all results net of taker fee and an explicit 1c half-spread.

football_data.walk_forward: only football-data seasons strictly before the match season
football_data.fallback: pooled five-league same-bucket prior seasons, still requiring n >= 30

executable_price.rule: last YES print in the window; a NO print at p is converted to YES = 1 - p
executable_price.ask: last YES print + 0.01 (one tick / modelled half-spread)
executable_price.lookahead: none; the print timestamp must be <= kickoff - 1h (and >= window start)

trade_filter.size: 1 share per triggered match; one match = one independent result

costs.fee_note: sports taker rate 0.05; makers pay 0; the 1c half-spread is already inside ask and is not charged twice

diagnostics: raw last print, zero fee and zero spread
